name: @sh/saucerswap
description: SaucerSwap V2 addresses, quotes, HTS token association and wrapping HBAR into WHBAR, for the recurring-buy scaffold-hbar template.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/write-cjs-package-json.mjs
scripts.test: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:live: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && SAUCERSWAP_LIVE=1 node --test dist/test/*.test.js
